column1: # Case table for the status line, read by BOTH runners' test suites
# (tests/test-statusline.sh and tests/test-statusline.ps1), so the Bash and
# PowerShell scripts are held to the same output for the same input.
#   zone      any = the output does not depend on the time zone
#             utc = a reset time is printed; the suite runs the script in UTC,
#                   and a runner that cannot force UTC (PowerShell on Windows)
#   mode      the script's argument; - means none (the default, spoken)
#   json      what Claude Code sends the script on stdin
#   expected  the exact line the script must print
#   label     what the case is called in the output
# Lines starting with # are comments; #> starts a new section heading.
